annotations.title: Turn an email on or off

description: Turn the scheduled client report email on or off for the signed-in person. Does not change push notifications.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

on.description: true turns the email on, false turns it off

name: mail_prefs_set
